fields.name: Rāmacandra Khān (Chatrabhoga)
fields.place: Bhadrakālī, north of Vāligrāma (Howrah); Chatrabhoga (24 Parganas; adhikārī); Jaleśvara (his subā)
fields.notes: Born 1480 in Makaranda Ghoṣ's family; official of Hussain Shah (titles Khān, Rāya, Mahāśaya), son-in-law of Purandara Khān Gopīnātha Vasu; adhikārī of Chatrabhoga, later Sher Shah's subahdār from Hijli to south Orissa. When Lord Caitanya came to Chatrabhoga after His sannyāsa he escorted Him at the risk of his life through the frontier war to Orissa (Caitanya-bhāgavata Antya 2). Not the Rāmacandra Khān of Benāpola (#1245).

fields.name: Rāmatanu Mukhopādhyāya «Bhāgavata-bhūṣaṇa»
fields.place: Nadia; Ulā near Rāṇāghāṭ; Jirāṭ Balāgaḍ (his sister's house); Navadvīpa; Dhaka; Dinajpur
fields.disciples: Nityānanda dāsa (his favourite); Gurudayāla Siṁha, zamindār of Kāṭdahā; many others
fields.notes: Of Nadia, second of four brothers; his elder brother Vedāntavāgīśa brought him to Gaura-bhakti. Master of the Bhāgavatam («Bhāgavata-bhūṣaṇa»); with Siddha Caitanya dāsa Bābā and Jiyaḍa Nṛsiṁha Barāṭ (#614) preached the Gaura-mantra in Bengal and founded Gaura communities; defeated the Śāktas. Died 1843/44 hearing Nāgarī-bhāva Gaura-kīrtanas, nursed by his disciple Nityānanda dāsa. His own guru is not named.

fields.disappearance: 1944, at Ekacakrā, after Nityānanda's appearance festival (the record's text)
fields.place: Born at Kīrtipura (Murshidabad); Tithāgrāma; Pāñcthupi (Harivāsara); Nīlācala and Jhāṅjpīṭā; Ekacakrā (from 1927)
fields.guru: Dīkṣā in the family of Jāhnavā Mātā (arranged by Kṛṣṇacandra Maṇḍala); veśa from Rādhāramaṇa-caraṇa dāsa Bābājī at Nīlācala
fields.notes: Of a Sat-śūdra family of Kīrtipura (parents Chavilāl and Garavinī). Brought up by Kṛṣṇacandra Maṇḍala and Banwārīlāl Siṁhajī; learned Manoharaśāhī kīrtana from Dīnu dāsa and from Advaita dāsa Bābājī's school; served the Harivāsara of Pāñcthupi. Took veśa from Rādhāramaṇa-caraṇa dāsa Bābājī (#1168). From 1927 restored and served the temples of Ekacakrā; died there in 1944: «Nitāi, give me my ticket».
